using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.Rendering;

// World-space animation: no camera-facing flipbook or sprite sheet.
[RequireComponent(typeof(MeshFilter), typeof(MeshRenderer))]
public class VFXForge3D : MonoBehaviour
{
    [Serializable] public class Segment { public Vector3 a, b; public float width, alpha; public string color; }
    [Serializable] public class Frame { public Segment[] segments; }
    [Serializable] public class AnimationData { public float duration; public Frame[] frames; }
    public TextAsset animationJson;
    public Material effectMaterial;
    public float playbackSpeed = 1;
    private AnimationData data;
    private Mesh[] meshes;
    private MeshFilter filter;
    private Material ownedMaterial;
    private float clock;

    void Start()
    {
        filter = GetComponent<MeshFilter>();
        if (!animationJson) { Debug.LogError("Assign the exported 3D animation JSON.", this); enabled = false; return; }
        data = JsonUtility.FromJson<AnimationData>(animationJson.text);
        if (data == null || data.frames == null || data.frames.Length == 0 || data.duration <= 0) { enabled = false; return; }
        if (!effectMaterial) {
            var shader = Shader.Find("VFXForge/WorldLines");
            if (!shader) { Debug.LogError("Import the exported WorldLines shader and assign its material.", this); enabled = false; return; }
            ownedMaterial = new Material(shader); effectMaterial = ownedMaterial;
        }
        GetComponent<MeshRenderer>().sharedMaterial = effectMaterial;
        meshes = new Mesh[data.frames.Length];
        // Build frames on demand to avoid a long startup stall.
        ShowFrame(0);
    }
    void Update() {
        clock = Mathf.Repeat(clock + Time.deltaTime * playbackSpeed, data.duration);
        ShowFrame(Mathf.Min(data.frames.Length - 1, Mathf.FloorToInt(clock / data.duration * data.frames.Length)));
    }
    void ShowFrame(int index) {
        if (!meshes[index]) meshes[index] = BuildMesh(data.frames[index]);
        filter.sharedMesh = meshes[index];
    }
    static Mesh BuildMesh(Frame frame) {
        var vertices = new List<Vector3>(); var colors = new List<Color>(); var indices = new List<int>();
        foreach (var s in frame.segments) {
            Vector3 direction = s.b - s.a;
            if (direction.sqrMagnitude < 0.0000001f || s.alpha <= 0) continue;
            direction.Normalize();
            Vector3 right = Vector3.Cross(direction, Mathf.Abs(direction.y) > .9f ? Vector3.right : Vector3.up).normalized * s.width * .5f;
            Vector3 up = Vector3.Cross(direction, right).normalized * s.width * .5f;
            Color color; if (!ColorUtility.TryParseHtmlString(s.color, out color)) color = Color.white;
            color.a = Mathf.Clamp01(s.alpha);
            int start = vertices.Count;
            foreach (var p in new[] { s.a, s.b }) foreach (var offset in new[] { right + up, -right + up, -right - up, right - up }) { vertices.Add(p + offset); colors.Add(color); }
            for (int side = 0; side < 4; side++) { int next = (side + 1) % 4; indices.AddRange(new[] { start+side,start+next,start+side+4,start+next,start+next+4,start+side+4 }); }
        }
        var mesh = new Mesh { name = "VFX Forge world frame", indexFormat = IndexFormat.UInt32 };
        mesh.SetVertices(vertices); mesh.SetColors(colors); mesh.SetTriangles(indices, 0); mesh.RecalculateBounds(); return mesh;
    }
    void OnDestroy() {
        if (meshes != null) foreach (var mesh in meshes) if (mesh) Destroy(mesh);
        if (ownedMaterial) Destroy(ownedMaterial);
    }
}
